targets.expr: label_join((sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]))) and on(instance,nic) (((sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]))) + (sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m])))) > 0), "hv", " | ", "instance", "nic")

label_join((sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]))) and on(instance,nic) (((sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]))) + (sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m])))) > 0), "hv", " | ", "instance", "nic")

label_join((max by(instance,nic) (100 * rate(windows_net_bytes_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) / clamp_min(windows_net_current_bandwidth_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}, 1))) and on(instance,nic) (((sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]))) + (sum by(instance,nic) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_discarded_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",nic!~".*[Ll]oopback.*|isatap.*|Teredo.*|6to4.*"}[5m])))) > 0), "hv", " | ", "instance", "nic")
